decisions.reason: This drain housing builds directly on our established drainage engineering and compatible system families, and its continued dedicated presentation suggests enough market acceptance to justify further refinement.

A floor-level shower drainage system sits at the center of our knowledge base and future direction toward accessible, low-profile bathroom solutions, and its stronger visibility after launch indicates positive learning and traction.
Although its visibility fell after launch, a designer shower drain still fits our core competence in design-conscious shower drainage and can be improved within the existing product architecture.
The shower element with integrated slope is highly complementary to our installation and waterproofing know-how, so even modest web prominence is enough to keep it as a system-enabling product.

The backflow-protected basement floor drain shows strong market relevance and uses our core drainage expertise in a technically demanding application where our R&D and application guidance create clear advantage.

The air-admittance valve appears more peripheral to our main drainage-system knowledge base and showed only limited market emphasis, so resources are better concentrated on products where our absorptive capacity is stronger.
